title: 看着脚放稳
description: 成人低位攀爬时视线落在脚点，脚尖完成一次短距离换点。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult pauses on a low slab wall and looks directly at a large foothold beneath the left foot. One hand rests on a generous jug and the other maintains a comfortable support; the right shoe stays on another broad hold near the mat. Capture the moment the left toe settles, with a quiet upper body and no blind reaching. The wall uses sparse rounded holds and a clear continuous padded floor. Use transparent watercolor with reserved paper light, fluid contours, a restrained indigo and warm sienna palette, and generous breathing room. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
